entities.name: Dokai
entities.description: Human monk of Kamigawa from the Kami War, a grand master who could turn earth into elementals.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest the Soratami called an unruly garden.

events.summary: Dokai proposed sending the Soratami a Child of Thorns to prove them wrong about the Jukai forest.
